surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: The Maple Leafs edge the Islanders
paras: Colton Sissons scored his first goal for Toronto early in the first to open the scoring. Easton Cowan made it 2-0 on the power play less than five minutes later, and that goal turned out to be the winner. Emil Heineman cut Toronto’s lead to 2-1 shorthanded with just under six minutes left.
Nothing much separated these two on the chances. This one could have gone either way. Anthony Stolarz made 26 saves for the Maple Leafs, and Ilya Sorokin stopped 24 of 26 at the other end.
The Maple Leafs killed all four Islanders power plays. The Leafs improved to 1-1-0, tied for first in the NHL in points, while the Islanders dropped to 0-1-0, still last in the NHL.
